name: agentdev-guard-connection
description: Senpi host guard connection. Interprets Senpi edit operations (write/edit/patch equivalents) and raw command write paths into the canonical guard common judgments (src/common/guards/). Host-specific edit semantics are localised in this interpretation layer; no side effects on rejection; uninterpretable inputs fail closed. Repo-local connection: excluded from consumer distribution and projected by the self-host sync.
